section.subsection: There is created within the General Fund a restricted account known as the "Targeted Advertising Tax Restricted Account."
The account consists of:revenue collected from the tax imposed by Section 59-35-201; andamounts appropriated by the Legislature.

Subject to appropriation, money in the account may be used for:child literacy programs;civic information programs;youth sports or recreational programs;youth volunteerism programs;mental health programs or services for children;adoption and foster care services;public education or awareness campaigns regarding the effects of targeted advertising on children, families, and adults; andoffsetting the costs of programs or services described in Subsections (3)(a) through (g).
